title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1972-07-18

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with generally great sound despite occasional glitches, highlighted by a smoking Truckin > Dark Star > Comes‑A‑Time sequence and soaring Garcia guitar.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high energy and memorable jams – especially the Truckin → Dark Star → Comes A Time stretch, plus standout renditions of Sing Me Back Home and the NFA/Going Down The Road Feeling Bad close.  While most listeners describe the sound as clear and enjoyable, a few note small squeaks, buzzes and an early cut on Stella Blue, suggesting a good‑but‑not‑perfect soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (many 5‑star comments) weighted at 70% and generally good recording quality with minor glitches weighted at 30% yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear and enjoyable sound; occasional squeaks, buzzing (notably during Truckin'), small stage bleed, and an early cut on Stella Blue. Most reviewers describe the audio as great despite these minor issues.

standout_songs: New Minglewood Blues > Going Down The Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions with a powerful second‑set jam sequence; third‑set (encore) highlighted by Donna Godchaux's vocals and solid closing numbers.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s playing is described as unstoppable, perfect tone, and a transcendent force especially on Dark Star and the Truckin' jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's piano/keyboard work noted as a turning point for the band’s sound in summer ’72; praised for adding new texture.
